subject: Final go-live / rollout planning call — availability and agenda
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
To: Ashley Johnson <ashley.j@stellarpay.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final go-live / rollout planning call — availability and agenda

Hi Ashley & Samir,

Congrats again on getting sign-off from your stakeholders — excited to get the rollout over the finish line. Before we create the calendar invite I wanted to align on:

- A 60-minute planning call to confirm cutover steps, rollback/fallback owners, monitoring & alerting, and procurement/checklist items.
- Suggested window: Tue Feb 10 or Wed Feb 11, morning PT (we can adjust for your timezone).
- Proposed attendees: Ashley (Eng Lead), Samir (SRE), Laura Meyers (CISO) — procurement can join for 15 mins to confirm contract/retention terms. From our side: me (AE), Grace (Solutions Eng), Rishi (Platform Eng), Markus (Customer Success Manager — will be on standby).

Draft agenda attached (cutover-plan-v3.pdf) — highlights: maintenance window: 2 hours, staged rollback, live traffic verification steps, and escalation contacts. Can you confirm who will own fallback (app vs infra) on your side so we can map RACI?

If those two dates don't work, please propose two alternative 60-min slots.

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.p@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187
[Attachment: cutover-plan-v3.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)]

From: Ashley Johnson <ashley.j@stellarpay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@stellarpay.com>, Laura Meyers <laura.meyers@stellarpay.com>, Procurement <procurement@stellarpay.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final go-live / rollout planning call — availability and agenda

Thanks Monica — appreciate the clear agenda. Tue Feb 10 AM PT works for our core team except Laura (CISO) who is traveling that day.

Laura can do Wed Feb 11 between 09:00-11:30 PT. Procurement can join for the first 20 minutes on either day to confirm retention/SLAs.

Owners on our side:
- Fallback/Rollback primary: Samir (SRE)
- App-level feature toggle rollback: Ashley (Eng Lead)
- Security validation owner: Laura (CISO)

If we keep Tue for the core eng run-through and do a short follow-up with Laura on Wed that could work.

Ashley
Senior Engineering Manager, StellarPay
ashley.j@stellarpay.com | +1 212-555-3320

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ashley Johnson <ashley.j@stellarpay.com>, Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final go-live / rollout planning call — availability and agenda

Ashley — that split approach sounds sensible. Proposed plan from our side:

- Tue Feb 10, 09:00-10:00 PT: Core cutover run-through (technical owners, validation steps, monitoring). Grace + Rishi will lead the step-by-step and timing.
- Wed Feb 11, 09:00-09:30 PT: Security sign-off + procurement check (Laura + Procurement). Markus will join the first 15 mins for any contractual clarifications.

I also added a short fallback checklist (fallback-checklist.xlsx) that maps each rollback activity to the owner and estimated time-to-recovery. Please review the owner mapping before Tue so we can keep the call tight.

Grace
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: fallback-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@stellarpay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.p@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ashley Johnson <ashley.j@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Laura Meyers <laura.meyers@stellarpay.com>, Procurement <procurement@stellarpay.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final go-live / rollout planning call — availability and agenda

Thanks — confirming I will own fallback/rollback on infra. A couple of practical asks before the run-through:

1) Can Redwood share the exact access table for service accounts + runbooks? (we need to load them into our incident console)
2) Any credential rotation expected during the cutover window? If so, please add to the agenda.

I reviewed the fallback checklist — looks good but please note: our infra rollback requires ~30 mins to revert traffic and validate state; app toggle rollback is <5 mins. We should allow room in the maintenance window.

Samir
SRE Manager, StellarPay
[On Mon, Feb 9, 2026 at 08:42 Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:]

All — thanks for the quick confirmations. I’ll create two invites:

1) Tue Feb 10, 09:00-10:00 PT — Core Cutover Run-through (Grace & Rishi lead) — Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=final-go-live-stellarpay
2) Wed Feb 11, 09:00-09:30 PT — Security & Procurement sign-off (Laura + Procurement)

Action items before Tue:
- Rishi: post the exact access table and runbook link to the Confluence page.
- Samir: confirm expected infra rollback time in the checklist (noted: ~30 mins).
- Ashley: confirm who will be on call from your side for the first 20 minutes for procurement items.
- All: please review cutover-plan-v3.pdf and fallback-checklist.xlsx and comment by EOD Mon.

I’ve attached an access summary doc (access-and-credentials.md) that lists the service accounts we'll need elevated for the window. See attachments and the Confluence link for details.

Will send calendar invites shortly — if there are changes to attendee list, reply-all with names/emails to make sure invites go to the right people.

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: access-and-credentials.md (MD, 3 KB)]

All — confirmed and accepted the calendar invites. Laura will join the Wed short sync. Procurement (procurement@stellarpay.com) will join Tue for the first 20 mins.

Two quick notes:
- We added an internal checkpoint 1 hour before the maintenance window to ensure teams are ready — I will share that time once internal confirmations are in.
- Please include an explicit rollback trigger in the agenda (e.g., if error rate > 3% for 5 minutes or if X latency threshold breached).

Looking forward to the run-through.

Ashley
